text:
maria: PR 6123 touches on an on-prem auth change for the VPC sidecar. Planning to merge tomorrow morning (10:00 PT slot). Need a quick sec/privacy sanity check — token lifetimes + any new secret files under /etc/redwood/keys. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6123

jess: looking now, can you paste the kube manifest change? quick scan shows the serviceAccount binding might be broader than intended.

maria: pasted the minimal change below — it's the service account role binding we added:

```yaml
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: redwood-sidecar-access
  namespace: redwood-system
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: redwood-sidecar-readwrite
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: redwood-sidecar
    namespace: redwood-system
```

We initially used a ClusterRole because of cross-namespace secret access. open to alternatives.

alex: that ClusterRole can be dangerous. Why cluster-level? can we scope to namespace or use a specific Role with explicit verbs? also any new env var with plaintext secret?

maria: no plaintext envs. We were mounting a key under /etc/redwood/keys via a secret volume. snippet from container spec:

```yaml
volumes:
  - name: redwood-keys
    secret:
      secretName: redwood-onprem-keys
containers:
  - name: sidecar
    volumeMounts:
      - name: redwood-keys
        mountPath: /etc/redwood/keys
    env:
      - name: REDWOOD_KEY_PATH
        value: /etc/redwood/keys/key.pem
```

devsec-bot: automated-scan: flagged mount path '/etc/redwood/keys' as high-risk for on-prem. Recommendation: avoid cluster-level RBAC and prefer projected service account tokens or CSI secrets driver with encryption-at-rest. See scan id: DS-2026-149.

sam: @maria can we move to CSI secret provider + KMS annotation? For on-prem that might require customers to run a small KMS-compatible agent, but we should at least avoid cluster-wide roles. For Dedicated/hosted customers we must use KMS.

jess: agree with sam. Hold merge until RBAC is narrowed and secret handling is changed. I can push a tiny patch to switch RoleBinding -> Role (namespace) and change mount to projected SA token if you want me to.

maria: thanks — will hold. pushing change now. If not approved by EOD we'll move to the next deploy slot.

ops-oncall: FYI deploy window 10:00 PT tomorrow still free but we'll block if sec holds.

alex: if jess patches the RBAC and we change to projected tokens, I'm fine to approve. Also add a short note in release notes about on-prem behavior change.

maria: updated PR: removed ClusterRole dependency, switched to projected SA token, moved key path to /var/lib/redwood/keys (CSI-ready), and added annotation for KMS-encryption: "redwood.kms/encrypted: 'true'". PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6123

jess: quick LGTM, left one nit about comment formatting -> non-blocking.

alex: Approved. @ops-oncall you good with the slot? :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: yep, we can proceed. i'll watch the rollout and check auth failures in the first 15m.

maria: thanks all — will merge in the 10:00 PT slot and update release notes + ops checklist. Ping me if anything else pops up. :pray:
